paragraphs: At handoff, operators review operating logs and dispatch plans. They monitor SCADA curves, adjust pressure-control valves, and inspect compressors and tanks for unusual sounds or leaks. During peak demand, they balance supply under instructions. Leak alarms trigger immediate isolation under emergency plans, followed by complete logs and hazard handoff.
